description: Source code for Azure Disk CSI translation in Kubernetes, including functions for translating in-tree volume specs to CSI, handling volume support checks, and managing topology labels.

classes.name: azureDiskCSITranslator
classes.description: Handles translation between in-tree Azure Disk volume specifications and CSI volume specifications.

methods.name: TranslateInTreeStorageClassToCSI
methods.description: Converts in-tree storage class parameters to CSI storage class.

methods.name: TranslateInTreeInlineVolumeToCSI
methods.description: Converts an in-tree AzureDisk volume to a CSI PersistentVolume.

methods.name: TranslateInTreePVToCSI
methods.description: Converts an in-tree PersistentVolume with AzureDisk to a CSI PersistentVolume.

methods.name: TranslateCSIPVToInTree
methods.description: Converts a CSI PersistentVolume with AzureDisk source back to an in-tree AzureDisk volume.

methods.name: CanSupport
methods.description: Checks if the plugin supports a given PV.

methods.name: CanSupportInline
methods.description: Checks if the plugin supports a given inline volume.

methods.name: GetInTreePluginName
methods.description: Returns the name of the in-tree plugin driver.

methods.name: GetCSIPluginName
methods.description: Returns the name of the CSI plugin.

methods.name: RepairVolumeHandle
methods.description: Repairs or returns the volume handle, default implementation returns the input handle.
